headline: Bitcoin is holding near $76,000 on a quiet Saturday after Friday's 11-week low, as US bitcoin funds lost another $412M on Friday and MEXC faces a US Treasury cut-off order.

market.asOf: From CoinGecko at about 07:55 UTC Sat 7 Nov (14:55 Bangkok). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Fear: CoinMarketCap's Fear & Greed Index read 31 (Fear band) at about 07:55 UTC Sat 7 Nov; ChainCatcher's 7 Nov morning report put the Fear & Greed Index at 27 (Fear).

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $76,000 as US bitcoin funds see a second straight day of outflows
stories.summary: A much stronger than expected US jobs report raised the odds that the Fed raises interest rates in December, and bitcoin briefly fell below $75,000 on Friday. It has been roughly flat since. US spot bitcoin funds lost money for a second straight day on Friday.
points: Bitcoin was $75,959 on CoinGecko at about 07:55 UTC Saturday, with a 24h range of $74,921 to $76,266.
Friday's low was $74,762 per Cointelegraph, the weakest since 21 August.
US payrolls rose 165,000 in October against a 65,000 forecast and unemployment fell to 4.1%, per Cointelegraph.
Odds of a December rate hike rose from 66.9% to 76.8% on CME FedWatch after the data, per Cointelegraph.
US spot bitcoin funds lost a net $411.92M on Friday, with BlackRock's IBIT at -$403M and Fidelity's FBTC the only inflow at +$42.82M, per SoSoValue data via TokenPost.

sources.label: TokenPost: bitcoin ETFs lose $412M on 6 Nov

stories.title: US Treasury cuts crypto exchange MEXC off from the US financial system, and a partner pulls out
stories.summary: The US Treasury issued an order cutting crypto exchange MEXC Global off from the US financial system, alleging about $16B in transactions linked to Iran, North Korea and Russia. Reserve said it will stop providing liquidity for two tokens, LCAP and CMC20, on MEXC.
points: The Treasury alleges about $16B of transactions connected to Iran, North Korea and Russia went through MEXC, per The Block.
MEXC says it has anti-money-laundering controls and will block users in Iran, North Korea and other countries, per The Block.
Reserve is halting liquidity for its LCAP and CMC20 tokens on MEXC and says it will soon withdraw the funds it committed, per ChainCatcher.

sources.label: The Block: Treasury cuts off MEXC

stories.title: Binance hack: $3.1B still in hacker wallets as Binance plans to reopen withdrawals
stories.summary: Blockchain analysts at Elliptic say the hackers behind the Binance theft are slowly converting stolen coins into bitcoin, but only a negligible amount has likely been cashed out. Binance says it has replaced virtually all stolen assets and plans to reopen more withdrawals by the end of next week.
points: About $3.11B sits in addresses linked to the theft, $2.85B is frozen and $470M is unaccounted for, per The Block citing Elliptic.
About $124M of stolen tokens has been swapped into bitcoin, across more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains, per The Block.
The Block puts the total breach at $6.43B, citing Elliptic.
Binance aims to reopen HYPE, INJ, APT, PLASMA, NEAR and LTC withdrawals by the end of next week, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: hackers swap $124M into bitcoin

briefs.title: Ether ETFs: second day of outflows
briefs.summary: US spot ether funds lost a net $93.19M on Friday 6 Nov, led by BlackRock's ETHA at -$90.76M, per SoSoValue data via TokenPost.

briefs.title: US sanctions 8 Canadian money services firms
briefs.summary: OFAC sanctioned eight Canadian money services businesses it says turned Iranian rials and drug money into crypto, per the US Treasury.

briefs.title: China halts a Solana event in Shanghai
briefs.summary: A People's Bank of China official said authorities stopped Solana's "Accelerate" event over unauthorized promotion, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Treasury drops $250 crypto Travel Rule plan
briefs.summary: FinCEN and the Fed withdrew a 2020 proposal to lower the threshold for collecting transfer data from $3,000 to $250, per The Block.

briefs.title: Crypto-in-401(k) rule moves to White House review
briefs.summary: The Labor Department sent a proposed rule on alternative assets, including crypto, in 401(k) plans to the White House for review, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strive posts a $509M quarterly profit on bitcoin
briefs.summary: Strive reported Q3 net income of $509M, driven entirely by paper gains on its bitcoin, and now holds 43,124 BTC after buying 15,124 in October, per The Block.

Released just after 11pm CET, per MSCI. New rules for companies that mainly hold crypto take effect with this review and Strategy is at risk of removal, per The Block. Changes take effect at the close on 30 Nov. Veterans Day.

calendar.note: Expected: +0.4% on the month, core +0.3%, per Trading Economics. September: +1.3%, and +0.7% excluding food and energy, per the Labor Department.

calendar.note: Both listed on the Fed's November calendar.

The Fed held at 3.75-4.00% on 28 Oct in a 10-2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissented in favour of a hike, per Fortune. After the jobs report, December hike odds were 76.8% on CME FedWatch, per InvestmentNews.
